summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Studio 7 Miami calendar app. 12/12 pytest backend tests passed covering auth (login/me/invite validation), invites (admin-only, magic link generation), calendars (seed verification + CRUD + RBAC), bookings (member request -> admin approve/deny + manual booking + serialization anonymization for non-owners) and notifications (list + read-all). Frontend verified: login redirects to Calendar page, Month/Week/Day tabs + calendar toggles + New button + notification bell with unread badge all render; Members admin page shows invite form and returns copyable invite_link from stubbed email; Calendars and Requests pages load; seeded Photobooth + Studio 7 Miami shown; admin sidebar exposes Members & Calendars nav items.

minor.issue: No overlap/conflict validation - two bookings can overlap the same calendar slot. Not blocking MVP but worth flagging.
No validation that end_time > start_time or that date is a valid YYYY-MM-DD / HH:MM format (accepts arbitrary strings).
Deleting a calendar does not cascade or block when existing bookings reference it, leaving orphaned bookings.

issues: Weekday header row (SUN..SAT) uses low-contrast grey text on dark background - readable but borderline.

action_items: (Optional) Add booking time-range validation and overlap detection before accepting request/manual bookings
(Optional) Prevent calendar deletion when bookings exist (or cascade-delete)
(Optional) Slightly increase contrast on weekday header labels in Calendar month view
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - works but should migrate to lifespan context manager
No rate-limit / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook suggests lockout after 5 fails) - not implemented
JWT secret is read from env correctly; bcrypt hashes start with $2b$ as required; _id excluded in all projections; good overall hygiene
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject - fine here because frontend uses Bearer token (not cookies), but flag for future cookie-based auth
test_credentials: Admin seven@studio7miami.com / Studio7Miami (seeded). Test members created dynamically via invite flow (emails prefixed test_member_*)
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral invites/members/bookings/calendars with TEST_ or test_member_ prefixes. Bookings cleaned up; members + invites remain in DB (idempotent tests use unique uuid emails).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 pytest backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_api.py pass against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Stubs: gcal_push_event returns 'gcal_mock_*' id; /api/invites returns invite_link in body. Admin login + member registration via invite + booking approve/deny all verified end-to-end. Frontend sidebar/top-bar notification bell uses unique structure; reach it via '.relative button' near top-right if needed (data-testid not currently added).
